newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS FRIDAY FIRMER ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS FRIDAY FIRMER ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted firmer on most key units in an interbank market that opened fairly long on foreign currency on Friday, foreign exchange dealers said.

"The market is basically very quiet at the moment. I don't foresee any big movements today but if the Reserve Bank doesn't come in today (to buy foreign currency), I expect the dollar to appreciate, but only a little," one dealer said.

At around 0820 GMT the local unit was trading at 11.3875/3975 against the U.S. dollar, a touch firmer from Thursday's 11.3900/4000 but was quoted softer on sterling at 19.2700/2980 compared to 19.2260/2550.
It gained versus the mark to 6.4900/4970 from 6.5100/5140 and to 2.4990/5030 against the rand from 2.5030/5040.
